visual_action: The video shows Donald Trump walking on a red carpet. A screenshot of a tweet from 'Republicans against Trump' is overlaid, which claims Trump buys shoes for his allies. The video then transitions to show Marco Rubio's face overlaid on a shot of him on an escalator, followed by a close-up shot of a man's foot in an oversized-looking black dress shoe.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown at the beginning of the video and is the subject of the overlaid tweet, which states he has been 'buying $145 Florsheim dress shoes for allies'.

cast.name: Marco Rubio
cast.evidence: His face is shown in a dissolve, and the overlaid tweet names him as having been 'photographed wearing a pair Trump ordered for him'.

cast.name: Republicans against Trump
cast.evidence: The name and Twitter handle (@RpsAgainstTrump) of the account are visible on the overlaid tweet.

cast.name: Florsheim
cast.evidence: The brand is mentioned in the on-screen text: 'buying $145 Florsheim dress shoes'.

on_screen_text.text: Republicans against Trump @RpsAgainstTrump According to media reports, Donald Trump has been buying $145 Florsheim dress shoes for allies in his inner circle, and people are reportedly 'afraid not to wear them.' Marco Rubio was photographed wearing a pair Trump ordered for him by just guessing his size. They looked noticeably too big.

spoken_summary: A male voice asks, "And why aren't you in uniform?"
audio_music: A spoken line, 'And why aren't you in uniform?', is layered over clomping walking sound effects and a subtle, atmospheric electronic music track. The audio is used to mockingly frame the shoes as a 'uniform'.
editing_pacing: The video uses slow pacing with dissolves, overlays, and static shots. It shows a clip of Trump, then overlays a tweet, then dissolves to a composite shot of Marco Rubio, and finally cuts to a close-up of a shoe.
cultural_references: The audio clip 'And why aren't you in uniform?' is a quote from the character Gunnery Sergeant Hartman in the film *Full Metal Jacket*.
central_claim: Donald Trump is a controlling leader who forces his allies, like Marco Rubio, into subservient and humiliating acts, such as wearing ill-fitting shoes he personally bought for them.
intended_effect: To make the viewer mock Donald Trump for his bizarre behavior and Marco Rubio for his apparent submissiveness.
uncertainty_flags: It is not possible to confirm from the video alone that the close-up of the large shoe is actually on Marco Rubio's foot.
